full_page.content:
Page 154 June 27 Pierre Gentile - 16 mo. - water on brain; otherwise well develop'd
Stanley E. Webb - 18 - birth injury has had right side paralyzed ever since.
Mrs. Agnes Sielof - 42 - Asthna - hay fever and pains in side; has been lutheran but is taking instructions. Enrolled as annual member.
Flossie E. Laura - 42 - of Rockwood, Mich. - heart leakage, sinus, stomach, etc constantly sick for 13 yrs. Here To-day ......
June 29 Geo. Kuptz - 32 - tumor on brain - fears operation - has wife and two small children.
Henry Heuser - 57 - serious complication of stomach, liver, gall. Has family of wife and four daughters. Wife and daughter here ask for prayers.
Dorothy L. Lovig of New Haven Conn. - 11 - T. B. of hip since two yrs. old. Mother here To-day Enrolls her 5.
Page 155 June Warren J. MacMillan - 48 - Raynaud's disease - very peculiar - like frost-bitten extremities ... has been treating for 20 years. Twelve years ago had operation which he believed did help some. has two fingers whole and his thumbs. Enrolls To-day 5.00
Rev. Fr. Sharp .... 45 yrs. ordained - heart & heat ....
Lillian Pinsk - 20 - married only a month. Husband jealous of her even to come home, etc, etc, crying every day.
July
1944, July
2 Baby Kenneth Simpson - 8 mo. has "Oppenheimer's disease". no con- troll of muscles. Drs. entirely without hope - completely at sea as to any remedy. The child is remarkably large for eight months. Seems to listen patiently and beautifully smiles as if understanding. The Father not belonging to any denomination.
3 Thomas Williams - 50 - left home 3 yrs. ago - no word from him since . .. Wm
